renting.title: Contract & money
renting.description: How renting works in Da Nang

bullets.contract: Contracts run 3, 6, or 12 months; shorter terms shrink the choice and raise the price
bullets.deposit: Deposit is 1-2 months, pay monthly; short stays may require the full amount up front
bullets.agent: The agent commission is paid by the landlord - using an agent is free for you
bullets.bilingual: The contract is in Vietnamese and English; the owner rarely attends the signing
bullets.registration: At check-in the owner must register your place of residence
bullets.utilities: Ask what is included: electricity at 3,000-3,500 VND/kWh and water are often extra

trust.title: Inspection before signing
trust.description: What to check in and around the home

bullets.visit: Visit in person or request a dated video walkthrough
bullets.pests: Check for cockroaches and ants, look for mold
bullets.neighbors: Catch the neighbors and ask for their review of the building and area
bullets.walk: Walk around in the morning and evening - any construction or karaoke nearby?
bullets.meters: Photograph the water and electricity meter readings at check-in

culture.title: Manners that matter

do.1: Take off your shoes when entering homes and temples
do.2: Greet with "xin chào" - it is appreciated
do.3: Hand over and receive items with your right hand or both hands
do.4: Dress modestly in temples and government offices

dont.1: Do not leave chopsticks standing upright in rice
dont.2: Do not touch people on the head, including children
dont.3: Do not raise your voice - calm resolves conflicts
dont.4: Do not photograph people without consent

culture.note: Locals forgive slips - staying calm and smiling matters more than etiquette.

what.title: What we store
what.body: We store only your Telegram ID (to sign you in) and your chosen language. We do not store or request your name, phone number or chats.

why.title: Why
why.body: The Telegram ID is used to create your session and show content in your language. It is not used for anything else.

share.title: Data sharing
share.body: We do not share or sell your data. Everything is stored in our database (Supabase) and protected by access controls.
